rationale: RRC surged ~17.66% yesterday on an acquisition announcement (exchange ratio into EQT shares), meaning the stock is now trading as a merger arbitrage instrument rather than on its own technicals — the price is anchored to EQT's value times 0.987, not to intraday momentum. The last five 1-minute candles show a tight, low-volume consolidation just below the 9-EMA ($54.48) with no clear directional impulse, and at 78% of today's range with the session high at $54.70, there is limited upside before resistance. Without a clear edge in either direction on a deal-driven name, the risk/reward does not justify entry.
